test_cases.prompt: I need to switch to a fresh session. Write a handoff document.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes handoff skill to create a portable markdown summary of the current conversation context, saving to OS temp directory.
test_cases.notes: User explicitly requests session switch with handoff.

test_cases.prompt: Pass this work to a colleague. They need to continue where I left off.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes handoff skill to create a document that lets another developer pick up the work, with references to existing artifacts.

test_cases.prompt: The context window is getting long. Let's compact and continue in a fresh window.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes handoff skill to create a portable document for the fresh session, not compact within the current session.

test_cases.prompt: Review this PR for code quality issues.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes code-review skill instead of handoff. Code review is about evaluating code, not transferring context.
test_cases.notes: Code review is a sibling skill for evaluating diffs.

test_cases.prompt: Debug this intermittent test failure on CI.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes diagnosing-bugs skill instead of handoff. Bug diagnosis finds root cause, not context transfer.
test_cases.notes: diagnosing-bugs is the sibling skill for hard bugs.

test_cases.prompt: Fork this into its own session for parallel work.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes handoff skill to create a document for the parallel session, since subagent stays in same session but handoff creates portable document.
test_cases.notes: Edge case: parallel work needs portable document, not subagent.

test_cases.prompt: I want to continue working in the same session, just compress the context.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should suggest compact instead of handoff. Compact compresses within a session; handoff exports across sessions.
test_cases.notes: Edge case: user wants same-session compression, not cross-session transfer.
